name: app-merchant-transaction-card-over-street-cafe-photo
title: Merchant Transaction Card over Cafe Photo
whatItIs: A wide street photo of a barista handing a paper bag to a customer, with a white rounded transaction card over the bottom showing a merchant logo, category, price and reference number.
whatItMeans: Placing a UI card onto real-life imagery shows exactly what the data represents, linking the digital record to the physical moment.
techniques: UI card overlaid on documentary-style photography
Card anchored across the lower third without hiding faces
Merchant logo and category as the main hierarchy
Price and ID right-aligned in a contrasting weight
Soft stacked shadow beneath the card
bestFor: Storytelling that ties numbers to life

vocabulary.definition: An interface element placed over a photo.
A component showing one payment's details.
Candid, real-life photography used for authenticity.
